definitions.gcc_peak_lag: Lag of the dominant GCC-PHAT peak between left and right channels.
definitions.gcc_peak_value: Strength of the dominant GCC-PHAT peak after PHAT normalization.
definitions.ild: Interaural level difference derived from left/right channel energy.
definitions.reverb_ratio_proxy: Proxy for reverberant-versus-direct energy ratio used as a distance cue.
definitions.directness_proxy: Proxy for direct-sound clarity / onset sharpness used as a distance cue.
definitions.ild_low_band_db: Low-band interaural level difference in dB for roughly 200Hz-1.5kHz.
definitions.ild_high_band_db: High-band interaural level difference in dB for roughly 1.5kHz-6kHz.

notes: This schema defines explicit binaural features for the Part 2 dataset contract.
delta_binaural_cue_t is not stored as a primary step-level field; it is computed explicitly before temporal token assembly.
This schema replaces the previous 7.1-direction-based training contract.
